_comment: EQUIPA MCP server hardening (task 2452): privileged tool calls (equipa_dispatch, equipa_task_create) require EQUIPA_MCP_TOKEN. EQUIPA_MCP_COST_CAP_USD bounds 24h dispatch spend. EQUIPA_MCP_PROJECT_IDS optionally restricts task_create targets to a comma-separated allowlist.
_comment_paths: Agents run in the project directory and MCP servers inherit it (tasks 3120/3127). Every command, script, cwd, PYTHONPATH entry and --db-path must therefore be ABSOLUTE, and python -m needs -I or -P plus an absolute cwd; anything else refuses the dispatch. The Claude CLI currently ignores a per-server cwd and starts every server in the project directory, so -P (never put the cwd on sys.path) with an absolute PYTHONPATH is what makes -m load the trusted checkout; cwd is still required for CLIs that honour it. Replace every /path/to placeholder.
